headline: Trilegal advised broker on $309 million block sale of Paytm shares
sum: Resilient Asset Management B.V. has made a stake sale of 19,210,110 equity shares of One 97 Communications Limited (“Paytm”), representing ~3% of Paytm’s share capital, through a block sale aggregating to approximately $309 million.
detail: Resilient Asset Management B.V. has made a stake sale of 19,210,110 equity shares of One 97 Communications Limited (“Paytm”), representing ~3% of Paytm’s share capital, through a block sale aggregating to approximately $309 million. Trilegal represented the broker, Goldman Sachs (India) Securities Private Limited, on this stake sale. The transaction was led by Richa Choudhary (Partner) and Maitreya Rajurkar (Partner) and Sanya Chaudhari (Senior Associate).
